description: Source code for NotePadProvider class implementing an Android ContentProvider for notes database, including database creation, query, insert, delete, update, and stream data functionalities.

classes.name: NotePadProvider
classes.description: Android ContentProvider for managing notes database, supporting CRUD operations and data streaming.

classes.name: DatabaseHelper
classes.description: Helper class for creating and upgrading the notes SQLite database.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the provider and database helper.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Queries the notes database based on URI pattern, returns a Cursor with results.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns MIME type for given URI pattern.

methods.name: getStreamTypes
methods.description: Returns supported stream types for a URI.

methods.name: openTypedAssetFile
methods.description: Provides a file descriptor for streaming note data.

methods.name: writeDataToPipe
methods.description: Converts cursor data into a stream for clients.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes notes based on URI and selection criteria.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates existing notes based on URI and selection criteria.

methods.name: getOpenHelperForTest
methods.description: Provides access to the database helper for testing purposes.
